notes: Repository controls cannot stop out-of-repo AWS authority. This file records remaining gaps after in-repo enforcement. Do not treat this list as authorization to bypass the guard.
in_repo_enforced: signed receipts for inventoried shared-target writers
fresh mutation-boundary live fingerprint with required fields and captured_at
exclusive lock required for every shared-target mutation (omit lease or require_exclusive_lock fails)
accepted composition candidate content hashes (file names alone fail)
preserved-member integrity fails when live or candidate hashes are missing
verified git-merge-base ancestry observed via git rev-parse/merge-base (caller JSON is not evidence)
candidate hashes observed from artifact bytes by scripts/deployment-guard/lib/observe.mjs
stale SPA dist and stale full Lambda package rejection
bypass scanner for registered CLI writers

gaps.summary: A human or agent with AWS credentials can still call aws lambda update-function-code, aws s3 cp, or CloudFront APIs outside this repository.
gaps.mitigation: IAM deny on shared functions/buckets except a dedicated deploy role that requires RevisionId CAS. Not applied in this workstream.

gaps.summary: Leases live under .deployment-guard/ in the checkout. Separate machines, CloudShell sessions, or unsynchronized worktrees do not share the lock unless they point CHECKSOPS_DEPLOYMENT_GUARD_ROOT at the same directory.
gaps.mitigation: Require a shared lock root for staging/production apply, plus IAM so only the guarded role can write.

gaps.summary: Receipt MACs use a gitignored local issuer key. A process that can read that key or call issueReceipt after acquireLease can mint a valid receipt.
gaps.mitigation: Treat receipts as collision protection, not an AWS security boundary.

gaps.summary: If a Cursor chat environment has AWS credentials, it can invoke the AWS CLI directly even after in-repo scripts refuse.
gaps.mitigation: Do not grant Cursor oneshot roles lambda:UpdateFunctionCode, s3:PutObject on index.html, or CloudFront mutate on shared targets.

gaps.summary: CODEOWNERS is advisory until branch protection requires owner review and disables administrator bypass.
Lambda application code uses S3 PutObject for tenant files. Those are data-plane writes, not deploys, and are not receipt-gated.
gaps.mitigation: Keep scanner focused on deploy-time writers. Do not confuse file uploads with SPA/Lambda deploys.

gaps.summary: Recommended IAM denies from ops/deployment-guard/README.md are not applied by this workstream.
